verdict.rationale: The Expenses API documents receipt match and receipt uploads, so uploaded receipts can be matched to card expenses. Brex also markets 'automated receipts' as part of expense management. The evidence is limited to one-line claims, and the email path in the story is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: evidence of email-forwarding receipt capture, in-depth docs on how auto-matching attaches receipts to the correct transaction, and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
